findings.source_section: 43 Completion Report / Optional Post-Completion Commit, item 2
findings.related_section: 33.1 Publication of Existing Governed Process Records; also Traceability 30.1 Publication and incomplete writes
findings.issue: The optional post-completion route requires authorization records to exist before Commit/Push, then directs appending the resulting commit identity to the same authorization record without specifying an immutable linked-record route.
evidence: Before any Commit or Push under this section, both of the following separate, attributable human-gate records must exist under the Work ID
After creating an authorized commit, append the full resulting commit identity to this same authorization record.

Published final records must not be modified in place. Draft preparation is limited to the actor's own designated unpublished output. Subsequent corrections or supersession must use linked new records under the applicable governed process.
findings.impact: Limited prospective record-handling ambiguity in an optional, uninvoked post-completion route. A literal in-place append would violate final-record immutability; a compliant linked successor may be intended but is not stated. No actual authorization mutation, unauthorized commit or push is established.
findings.recommended_resolution: Through Finding Investigation and Corrective Change Decision, clarify how a later commit identity is added by an authorized linked new immutable record while retaining the original authorization and exact staged-diff binding. Obtain required Human decision/exact approval before any change.
findings.human_decision_reason: The audit cannot select or implement an unstated record-update convention or grant publication/commit authority. The responsible Human must decide any clarification through governed change control.
findings.not_a_reopening: New source-text ambiguity; not historical GOV-001/GOV-002 or clarified GOV-AUD-20261102-001.

finding_citations.quote: A Governance Remediation cycle may be marked `COMPLETE` once the required full Governance Audit is `CONSISTENT`; Commit and Push remain separate optional actions and are never automatic. Before any Commit or Push under this section, both of the following separate, attributable human-gate records must exist under the Work ID and contain an explicit `YES` decision for the exact subject stated in that record. A `NO`, missing, ambiguous, stale, or mismatched decision blocks the action.

2. **Commit/Push Authorization (YES/NO):** Commit/Push authorization is a separate human decision, not Human Acceptance. It must identify the exact reviewed staged diff by an unambiguous content fingerprint, the exact staged file list, the Work ID, and the action or actions authorized. After creating an authorized commit, append the full resulting commit identity to this same authorization record. A Push is permitted only if the record expressly authorizes Push, the resulting commit identity has been bound in the record, and the commit being pushed matches that identity.

Published final records must not be modified in place. Draft preparation is limited to the actor's own designated unpublished output. Subsequent corrections or supersession must use linked new records under the applicable governed process.
